summary: Completed testing of 3 bug fixes for ProjectDash. All backend API tests pass (8/8). All frontend UI flows verified working.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/group/users creates user AND employee record
Backend: Created user appears in GET /api/employees with correct fields
Backend: POST /api/group/invite returns email_sent:true when SMTP configured
Backend: Invited user appears in GET /api/employees
Backend: POST /api/invoices/{id}/send queues email and updates status to 'sent'
Backend: Invoice send with custom recipient email works
Backend: Invoice send without any email returns 400 (proper validation)
Frontend: Create User dialog opens, form fillable, submit works
Frontend: Success toast 'User created successfully' appears
Frontend: Created user appears in Payroll employees list
Frontend: Invite User dialog opens, form fillable
Frontend: Invite submit shows 'User invited successfully' toast
Frontend: Dialog displays temporary password with copy button
Frontend: Invoice detail page shows 'Send Email' button
Frontend: Send Invoice dialog shows recipient email and preview
Frontend: Invoice send shows success toast with recipient email
Frontend: Invoice status updates to 'sent' after sending
seed_data_creation: Multiple test users and invoices created during testing (prefixed with test_, invite_, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three reported issues all fixed and verified: 1) create_user_directly and invite_user now auto-create entries in 'employees' collection. 2) invite_user sends styled HTML email with credentials via SMTP (Brevo configured). 3) send_invoice_email uses group_id for proper SMTP config. SMTP is fully working - emails actually sent.

fix_1_create_user_appears_in_payroll.backend_evidence: POST /api/group/users creates both user and employee record. GET /api/employees returns the new user.
fix_1_create_user_appears_in_payroll.frontend_evidence: Create User dialog → success toast → user appears in Payroll employees tab

fix_2_invite_sends_email.backend_evidence: POST /api/group/invite returns email_sent:true, creates employee record
fix_2_invite_sends_email.frontend_evidence: Invite User dialog → success toast 'User invited successfully' → dialog shows temporary password

fix_3_invoice_sending_works.backend_evidence: POST /api/invoices/{id}/send returns success, updates status to 'sent'
fix_3_invoice_sending_works.frontend_evidence: Send Email button → dialog with recipient → Send Invoice → success toast 'Invoice sent to [email]'

email_functionality.note: Emails are actually being sent - not mocked
